units.en: For armor technology without ⟦0⟧, see the separate ⟦1⟧ page.

⟦0⟧ replaces the basic armor technology system with a more modular system that feeds into the ⟦1⟧. Rather than researching dedicated vehicles, the new system focuses on researching only the chassis for entire classes of vehicles, with a few armor technologies also unlocking new armor and special modules. Importantly, the armaments used by tanks in the ⟦2⟧, which are also used to dictate which specialized roles a given armor variant can take, are researched as part of ⟦3⟧ instead, and many powerful special modules require research in other technology trees, such as ⟦4⟧ or ⟦5⟧.

With the introduction of special projects in ⟦0⟧ and the accompanying ⟦1⟧, all armor technologies now also generate land warfare breakthrough progress while being researched. Armor technologies are also particularly intertwined with the ⟦2⟧ land warfare special project.

These technologies unlock new chassis on top of which new vehicles can be designed in the ⟦0⟧. The first chassis technology is unspecialized and unlocks a huge array of basic armored vehicle modules. Subsequent chassis technologies are far more specialized in what they unlock.

Inter-War Tank DevelopmentThe tank has proven itself a powerful weapon in the Great War. While development has slowed in the intervening years, it is no doubt going to play a major role in the wars to come.

These technologies serve to unlock new chassis that can be used for ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, and ⟦3⟧, as well as the ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧, and, with ⟦6⟧, ⟦7⟧ ⟦8⟧. They also help unlock ⟦9⟧ for amphibious designs, and their chassis can be used for ⟦10⟧ designs.

Light chassis tend to be cheap and make for faster and more reliable vehicles, especially in the earlygame, but they also tend to have little armor, far less breakthrough than their heavier counterparts, and far more limited armament options, especially in the later years, when they act far better as more specialized combat support vehicles or in support companies than as frontline tanks.

Basic Light Tank ChassisTechnological advances have made the designs of the immediate post-war period effectively obsolete. The modern battlefield requires a new, clean design incorporating advances in metallurgy and interior layout.
Improved Light Tank ChassisA further iteration based on the experiences gained with previous light tanks, this chassis allows for better reliability and maintenance.

Advanced Light Tank ChassisWith medium tanks increasingly taking center stage in the fight, light tanks have largely been relegated to supporting roles. A new chassis design is needed that takes the needs of these roles into account.

This pair of technologies first unlocks a rather limited chassis for ⟦0⟧ and then unlocks a special module that can be used to make more flexible ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, and ⟦3⟧ amphibious tank designs. These units tend to be more expensive than their non-amphibious counterparts, but they are far better in wet ⟦4⟧ and at performing ⟦5⟧. Their designs can also use heavier weapons that are normally reserved for without being forced to be classified as such, allowing them to retain more breakthrough and benefit from certain ⟦6⟧ bonuses that are given only to tanks and not to armor variants.
All amphibious tanks count as special forces, benefitting from general bonuses given to special forces units, but also being limited by a country's special forces capacity.
Amphibious Tank ChassisA small tank hull specifically designed to float. To achieve this, strict limits have to be set on the size of the weapon and the thickness of the armor the vehicle carries.
Amphibious DriveA set of floatation devices and a small screw allow this tank to quickly be rigged to traverse water, either from ship to shore or across a river.

These technologies serve to unlock new chassis that can be used for ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, and ⟦3⟧, as well as the ⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧. They can also be used for ⟦6⟧. In the late game, they can also be used to unlock modern chassis that can be used for ⟦7⟧, ⟦8⟧, ⟦9⟧, and ⟦10⟧.

Medium chassis vehicles tend to strike a good balance between cost and effectiveness. While not as cheap as their light chassis cousins, the improvements they offer in stats and armament options can be far greater relative to their cost increase, regularly making them the best choice in terms of stats-per-cost. Their heavy chassis cousins can still absolutely outclass them in terms of one-on-one combat performance, but are far more expensive and so are far harder to field in critical mass numbers compared to vehicles based on medium chassis.
Basic Medium Tank ChassisA balanced, mid-sized chassis that offers a lot flexibility for building a wide variety of vehicles.
Improved Medium Tank ChassisA balanced, mid-sized chassis that offers a lot flexibility for building a wide variety of vehicles.
Advanced Medium Tank ChassisA balanced, mid-sized chassis that offers a lot flexibility for building a wide variety of vehicles.

Modern Tank ChassisA modernized chassis that borrows heavily from previous medium tanks, but puts a much bigger emphasis on speed and maneuverability, while also allowing for more armor and bigger guns than usually carried on medium tanks. The result is a vehicle that can fill a wide variety of roles.
One of: Advanced Medium Tank Chassis Advanced Heavy Tank Chassis
Advanced Medium Tank Chassis Advanced Heavy Tank Chassis

These technologies serve to unlock new chassis that can be used for ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, and ⟦3⟧, as well as the ⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧. They can also be used for ⟦6⟧. In the late game, they can also be used to unlock super-heavy chassis that can be used for ⟦7⟧, ⟦8⟧, ⟦9⟧, and ⟦10⟧ ⟦11⟧; with ⟦12⟧, these can also lead to the development of equipment for the monstrous ⟦13⟧ ⟦14⟧. Heavy chassis technologies can act as alternative prerequisites to medium chassis technologies for unlocking modern chassis that can be used for ⟦15⟧, ⟦16⟧, ⟦17⟧, and ⟦18⟧.

Heavy chassis vehicles tend to be amazing in terms of combat effectiveness, but have incredibly high production and resource costs. They also tend to be much slower than their lighter cousins and receive greater ⟦0⟧ penalties than them in more adverse conditions. Still, on the attack on the battlefield, they are essentially peerless, and opponents who face these vehicles will either have to match them with their own or find a less conventional way of dealing with them.
Basic Heavy Tank ChassisA large chassis that can mount a heavy gun, thick armor, or both.
Improved Heavy Tank ChassisA large chassis that can mount a heavy gun, thick armor, or both.
Super-Heavy Tank ChassisA gigantic vehicle, capable of mounting the heaviest armor and the biggest gun, but consequently fairly slow and unreliable.
Advanced Heavy Tank ChassisA large chassis that can mount a heavy gun, thick armor, or both.

These technologies increase the maximum amount of armor upgrades available in the ⟦0⟧, allowing tanks to resist more damage at the expense of increased cost and decreased speed and reliability. Some also unlock new armor and defensive special modules.

Basic Armor ProtectionTanks during the Great War only had to contend with enemy small arms. As such, they got away with fairly thin armor. A new generation of anti-tank weaponry has made the battlefield a much more dangerous place for a tank, and much heavier protection is needed.
Enables Armor Upgrades values of 5 and above.
Armor Upgrades values of ⟦0⟧ and above.
Improved Armor ProtectionWith heavier and heavier anti-tank weapons being fielded around the world, the next generation of tanks will require even better protection.
Enables Armor Upgrades values of 10 and above.

Advanced Armor ProtectionWhile the limit of deployed anti-tank guns has likely been reached, a new generation of tanks will carry more advanced weaponry, which is able to pierce any current level of protection at long range.
Enables Armor Upgrades values of 15 and above. Armored Skirts
Armor Upgrades values of ⟦0⟧ and above. ⟦1⟧

Modern Armor ProtectionDuring the war, the threats faced by tanks have multiplied, from enemy tanks, anti-tank guns, dedicated tank destroyers, all the way to modern infantry weapons firing shaped charges that can penetrate even heavy armor. We must develop new protection methods to keep our own tanks alive in the face of these threats.
Enables Armor Upgrades values of 18 and above.
These technologies increase the maximum amount of engine upgrades available in the ⟦0⟧, allowing tanks to move faster at the expense of increased cost and fuel usage and decreased reliability.
Basic EngineWhere the tanks of the Great War were slow, lumbering beasts, the modern tank relies very much on speed and mobility to achieve victory.
Enables Engine Upgrades values of 5 and above.
Engine Upgrades values of ⟦0⟧ and above.
Improved EngineWith bigger guns and heavier armor, the new generation of tanks requires a more powerful engine to remain mobile.
Enables Engine Upgrades values of 10 and above.

Advanced EngineMechanized warfare is a form of combat that requires fast decision making and fast movement of troops and supplies. If our tanks are to carry modern weapons and enough armor to survive on the battlefield, they require powerful engines to keep up with the motorized infantry.
Enables Engine Upgrades values of 15 and above.

Modern EngineThe numerous new additions to tanks made necessary by modern warfare have increased the weight of the vehicle substantially. To move all that mass around, we require engines that have a lot of power behind them.
Enables Engine Upgrades values of 18 and above.
This technology improves the ⟦0⟧ bonuses of ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, and ⟦3⟧ flame tanks and unlocks a more powerful armament for them.
Advanced FlamethrowerEnhanced flamethrower systems, ideal for clearing fortified positions and inflicting devastating damage in close-quarters combat.

These technologies improve the capabilities of or unlock new modules for ⟦0⟧. They all require having completed the ⟦1⟧ special project. Some also provide benefits for ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, and ⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧.

Naval Engine ConversionUtilizing naval engineering techniques such as reinforced crankshafts, high-torque transmissions and specialized cooling systems can enhance the power output and durability of Land Cruiser engines, allowing them to better manage the immense weight and stress.
Upgrades Land Cruisers, Super heavy tank: Supply Use: -2% Max Speed: +5%

Transmission ImprovementsRefined gear ratios, clutch mechanisms and torque converters to create more efficient transmissions capable of handling the extreme power and weight of Land Cruisers, improving overall mobility and reducing mechanical strain.
Upgrades Land Cruisers, Super heavy tank: Supply Use: -2% Reliability: +5% Forest: Movement: +20% Hills: Movement: +20% Mountain: Movement: +20% Jungle: Movement: +20%
⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧: Supply Use: -2% Reliability: +5% Forest: Movement: +20% Hills: Movement: +20% Mountain: Movement: +20% Jungle: Movement: +20%

Specialized Field ManualsDeveloping detailed training manuals tailored for Land Cruiser crews, covering unique operational procedures, maintenance protocols, and complex battlefield tactics required to effectively command these giant war machines.
Upgrades Land Cruisers: Entrenchment: +5% Organization: +10 HP: +5%
High-Impact Obliterator CannonSpecifically designed to penetrate extremely thick armor, this weapon’s high kinetic energy makes it a formidable counter against other super-heavy tanks.

Weapon Fire ControlImplementing advanced targeting optics, rangefinders, and gyroscopic stabilizers to enhance weapon accuracy and firing coordination, ensuring the guns can effectively engage targets despite their massive recoil and slow maneuverability.
